d:
Immerse yourself in the timeless magic of love with the enchanting title song of 'Dil Ka Rishta.' Featuring the mesmerizing Aishwarya Rai, this romantic Hindi melody is a symphony of emotions sung by the legendary trio - Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, and Kumar Sanu
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, Kumar Sanu
Music Director: Nadeem-Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer
Movie Cast & Crew:
Producer:Tips Films, Shabbir Boxwala, Aditya Rai
Director: Naresh Malhotra
